summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi All World 2x Daily ETF (WX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the Vanguard Total World Stock Index Fund ETF (Ticker: VT), which provides exposure to equities from around the world, including emerging markets. WX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
